title: Public profile
summary: Turns the public profile on or off and edits its name, bio and photo (ADR 0041). The profile is reachable only by the exact @ link; it has no search, followers or posts.

hasHandle.description: Without a handle the toggle is off and bipe_public_profile_needs_handle shows with a link to handle-pick.

bio.description: Plain text, up to bioMaxLength characters and bioMaxLines lines.

problem.description: Local check first (BipeProfileProblem), then the server reason of 400 profile_invalid or photo_invalid.

phase.description: saving: PUT /v1/me/profile (and the photo call) runs.

load.effect: GET /v1/me/profile. When the record is new, fills name and photo from the Matrix profile.

toggle.effect: Flips enabled. Turning off saves at once and hides the profile.

edit.effect: Sets the fields and runs the local check.

changePhoto.effect: Picks a photo, re-encodes it as JPEG of at most photoMaxPixels per side and photoMaxBytes, then PUT /v1/me/profile/photo. The server removes the metadata.

save.effect: PUT /v1/me/profile with enabled, name and bio. Shows bipe_public_profile_saved.

notes: Limits from registries/profiles.json; bipe_public_profile_name_too_long, bipe_public_profile_bio_too_long and bipe_public_profile_bio_too_many_lines take nameMaxLength, bioMaxLength and bioMaxLines.
The badge on the profile comes from the signed envelope only (GET /v1/badges/{userId}); the person cannot write it.
Minors: the server refuses to publish (ADR 0041). Show bipe_error_generic.

Bipe logic: BipeProfileProblem and BipePublicProfileRules.profileProblem and trim, jpegData (iOS, BipePublicProfile.swift), BipeAPIClient.myProfile, setMyProfile, setMyProfilePhoto, deleteMyProfilePhoto; BipeProfileProblem, BipeProfileRules.problem and saveProblem, BipePublicProfiles, BipeProfilePhotoEncoder (Android).
